content: Na mangota akanahota, mwatendelengana akabhanda bhino ghambone na ngita chapala Chapanga, kone nkombokela na mangota helahela nkwete Bhambo kunane kwa Chapanga.
Malaghilo
Munnyope Chapanga changatotokela, na pumunyopa Chapanga mukilolekeya na kunchenguu Chapanga.
Helahela mutujhopela na twenga kupala Chapanga atujhoghojolele nnyango gwa kutangacha Lilobhe tutangache chile jha Kilichitu. Kwa nhwalo gwa Lilobhe lya Mbone nenga ngohe mmi mu kipungo.
Ngohe unyopele nhoto kulongele ngita chiipala chile kulongelwa meke mbegha chile jhene.
Mme na malango palonge jha bhando bhangannyeketele Kilichitu, nkachane kutumii mbone kila pwache jhiminajho.
Machiko ghoha nnongela ghaumbone na gha kwajhangatii bhando, na umanye kwajhanguu mbone bhando machiko ghoha.
Nyambucho jha kujhomolela
Tikiko nnongo gwito jhutumpahile, na ntumiche jwahobholeka na ntumiche nnyito mulihengo lya Bhambo, nanobholela mihalo jhango jhoha.
Ndi nhwalo nintuma kwino ankangamalicha mwojho gwino kwa kunnobholela malobhe ghito.
Ahika kwenio pamonga na Onechimo, nnongo gwito jhutumpala na jwahobholeka jweniojho ndi nnyino. Jwenio ndi nnyino nanongolela mihalo jha ilebhe itendika pambano.
Alisitako, jwatabhitwe pamonga na nenga, inyambucha pamonga na Maluku nnongo mundo Banaba helahela inyambucha. Mukajhohine njwe malaghilo ghake. Papala kuhika kwino mupokele.

Na jwenio Yochuwa helahela jwakemitwa Yusito, jhunyohina mihalo jhake inyambucha. Pakate jha Akayahude bhibhapokii kihobholelo njwe, bhamba tu kanjika bhibhahenga lihengo pamonga na nenga kwa nhwalo gwa Unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga, bhene ndi bhingangamalicha hake nenga.

Epafula, mundo jwa kilambo chino, ntumiche jwa Yecho Kilichitu inyambucha. Machiko ghoha jwenio ighagha kunyopela kwa Chapanga nnyemangane nganganga, nkomale na nnyendelela kuhobholela na kuhenga ghighanhalalicha Chapanga.
Nihoto kulonge ahenga lihengo kwa nhwalo gwino mangota na kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bha ku Laodikiya na bhala bhubhabhii ku Hilapole.
Luka, jhola nng'anga gwito jhutumpala na Dema bhinyambucha.
Mwajhambuche akalongo bhito bhubhabhii ku Laodikiya na nnombo gwito Nifa pamonga na lilongo lyoha lya bhando lilinyeketii Kilichitu lilikongana kajhake.
Anda nnyomolela kuchoma baluwa jhenje, mwapela bhajhino bhibhanyeketii Kilichitu bhu ku Laodikeya na bhene bhaichome, na baluwa jhinajhandikile bhando bhu ku Laodikiya na mangota bhampele nchome.
Na munobholele Alukipo, “Nyomole lihengo lyapokii kuhumii kwa Bhambo.”
Ne Pauli nyandike ghanga kwa lubhoko lwango namwete, ninyambucha. Nkomboka nenga mmii mukipungo! Naninyopela umbone kubhoke kwa Chapanga.
